answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, as each one must be independent on the atlas graph and each exposes its bond to the knoll slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the yarrow audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
